policy.description: Raise the CT main rate from 25% to 28% from 1 April 2027

summary: Placeholder research summary (mock mode): no live sources were consulted. Official costings include behavioural responses [E1], taxable profits respond to the rate [E2], and investment responds to the cost of capital [E3]. Profit shifting [E4], the economic cycle [E5] and changes to capital allowances [E6] complicate comparisons with past changes.
research_questions: What revenue effects did official costings and observed receipts show for past UK corporation tax main-rate changes?

How does the corporation tax rate affect business investment through the user cost of capital?
